traceId.description: A unique identifier for the transaction. Also used to detect duplicate messages received. Matches the traceId of the incoming current_stop message

spanId.description: A unique identifier for an individual step of a transaction. Consists of the spanId from the current_stop message and a new UUID for this step, separated by a colon.

loggedIn.description: Whether or not the user is logged in to RuterSalg

vehicleRef.description: A reference to the Progress event that triggered this message. Matches the traceId from the Progress event.

progressRef.description: A reference to the Progress event that triggered this message. Matches the traceId from the Progress event.

lineRef.description: A reference to the Progress event that triggered this message. Matches the traceId from the Progress event.

assignmentRef.description: A reference to the Progress event that triggered this message. Matches the traceId from the Progress event.

actualCallRef.description: A reference to the Progress event that triggered this message. Matches the traceId from the Progress event.

chainId.description: A reference to the Progress event that triggered this message. Matches the traceId from the Progress event.

journeyRef.description: Last journeyRef obtained by the app

tariffZone.description: The tariff zone the vehicle is currently in

appVersion.description: Version of the RuterSalg app that sent the message

userId.description: The userId of the logged in user
